task: Write an immutable provenance manifest for dataset ingestion runs and stop silent destructive overwrite of an existing LanceDB collection (#14, scoped slice)

events.summary: Scoped to a new dataset_manifest.py module, its call sites in ingest_host.py, the data_ingest.rs surfacing of dataset_version/manifest_path, and one D-registry row (D39); DVC backup linkage, offline export/import, incremental ingestion, partial-ingestion crash recovery and the backend compatibility matrix are explicitly out of scope for this slice
ingest_host.py re-created an existing LanceDB collection in overwrite mode with no recorded dataset identity, so a re-run from a different source snapshot silently destroyed the prior index

Added scripts/data/dataset_manifest.py (compute_dataset_version/build_dataset_manifest/write_dataset_manifest/check_overwrite_guard) and wired it into ingest_host.py's indexing node; dataset_version is a sha256 over normalized source identity, per-document content hashes, chunk size/overlap, embedding model id and index schema version

First review pass returned DO NOT SHIP: dataset_version was not deterministic because source_path entered the hash unnormalized, and a manifest-write failure could flip a successful ingestion to a reported failure. Fixed by resolving local/file source_path to a canonical absolute path before hashing (URL sources keep the URL as identity), sorting the document list before hashing, isolating write_dataset_manifest in its own try/except that demotes to a warning (matching D37's already-settled MLX manifest behavior), collapsing the redundant second check_overwrite_guard call, and updating docs/02-requirements.md section 4.1 to match the new IngestConfig/IngestedDatasetInfo fields

python3 -m py_compile clean on all three touched Python files; python3 -m pytest scripts/data/test_dataset_manifest.py -q: 16 passed (grown from 11 pre-review, the 5 new cases cover path normalization across relative/absolute/trailing-slash spellings, URL sources not being path-resolved, and the manifest-write warning path); make verify: 122 Rust tests passed, clippy -D warnings clean, tsc --noEmit clean, design lint clean, web build clean
events.scope: scripts/data/**, src-tauri crate, full make verify gate

events.summary: Scoped slice complete and verified by unit tests plus the full repository gate; the real ingestion path was not exercised end-to-end against a live embedding model in this change
